page.overview:
Who is Bahamut?

Bahamut is the King of the Dragons in the original Final Fantasy. He lives in a subterranean network underneath the Cardian Islands, and grants the class change to the Warriors of Light after they bring back a token of their courage, the rat's tail, from the Citadel of Trials. He states that he has not seen any humans in a while by the time the party visits him.

Bahamut is one of the Warriors of Light in the Final Fantasy manga by Yuu Kaimeiji.
